content: Yishi rhugaluke emwa Nyamuzinda, Ye warhujaganulaga ye wânarhufumya; Ye wârhushûrhaga, ye wânarhuba ebibande bîrhu.
Hano kugera nsiku ibirhi ârhugalulira obuzîne, oku lwa kasharhu ârhuyinamule rhunamubêreho.
Rhumanyîrire Nyamuzinda, rhumulongereze, okuli rhwâmubona, âyisha emwîrhu nka lumè, nka kula enkuba mpangûka ebombêza idaho.
Kurhi nakujira wâni Efrayimu? Kurhi nakujira wâni Yûda? Obuzigire bwinyu kwo buli nka citù ca lwikungu lwa sêzi, nka lumè lurhalegama.
Co carhumire mbatwa bihimbi n’abalêbi, mbayîrha n’enderho z’ekanwa kâni;
bulya buzigire nnonza, ci arhali nterekêro, bumanye bwa Nyamuzinda ci arhali ntûlo
Amabî ga mîra n’aga buno g’Israheli
Ci bôhe bene Adamu bàvunyire eciragâne, aho bannenganya.
Galaadi ciri cishagala ca bishumûsi, ciyunjwîre mukò.
Kula ebishungu bicîfulika, omurhwe gw’abadâhwa gudwîrhe gwayîrha omu njira y’e Sikemi; okuli, olugendo lwâbo nshonyi nkulu.
Ebi nabwîne e Beteli, birhankaderhwa: yo Efrayimu ajirira obubaraga, yo Israheli ahemukira.
Ci kwône nâwe Yûda, nkubîkîre byâwe bitya, hano nshubiyimânika olubaga lwâni.

footnotes.text: 6, 6 Lolà 2, 21; 2, 22; Amo 5, 21; 1 Sam 15, 22. Hoz 14, 3adesire oku oburherekêre bushingânîne kuli kugaluka emwa Nnâmahanga.
